title: Profiling and performance debugging
brief: Parse Chrome-trace fixtures for GPU busy time and gaps, diagnose a kernel from Nsight Compute counters, and gate a regression against a noisy baseline.
hints: GPU busy time is the union of the GPU intervals. Sort by start, merge overlaps, then add up. Summing durations counts two overlapping streams twice.
Count only cat kernel, gpu_memcpy, and gpu_memset. A gpu_user_annotation covers the whole region and is not GPU work.

A host sync shows up as a gap that begins where a sync call ends. In diagnose, check the rules in the docstring's order: a kernel that reads 32 sectors per request can also show 80% DRAM throughput, and the coalescing rule has to win.
Compare medians, not means. One 30 ms outlier in five runs moves the mean by 4 ms and the median by nothing.
